bio.text: Carrie Koelker, a Republican, represents District 33 in the Iowa Senate; the Iowa Legislature's biography lists Koelker as serving a second term.
The biography lists Koelker as Vice President of Community Engagement at Travel Dubuque and as Executive Director of Eastern Iowa Tourism from 2000 to 2023.
It says Koelker is a graduate of Iowa Lakes Community College, was born in 1970 in Stanton and lives in Dyersville.
